note: scanners/inputs.jsonl.gz holds the inputs; each scanner file holds one result per input, in order

scanners.units_target: units.py:118 _TARGET as _IS_TARGET.match(text): the end of the match, or null
scanners.units_sentence_end: units.py:222 _SENTENCE_END.finditer(line): [start, end of group 1, end of group 2]
scanners.units_opener: units.py:253 _OPENER.match(line, pos) at every pos: [pos, end] where it matches
scanners.units_named: units.py:342 _NAMED.match(line): [start, end] of group 1 and the match end, or null
scanners.slack_percent: slack_mapping.py:108 and slack_callback.py:163 %(?!hex hex): [start, end] of each match
